templates.name: app_automation_workflow
templates.title: App 自动化决策流程
templates.description: 从钉钉打卡自动化中提取的通用决策模式。任何'自动操作App X'的任务都应走这个流程：先检查API可用性→无API则检查急速模式→仍不行则模拟点击→都不行则人工介入。避免在错误方向上探索。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: long_form_writer
templates.title: 万字长文生成器
templates.description: 分章节并行生成长文并自动拼接润色。工作流化解决单次LLM输出长度限制：先生成大纲→迭代生成每章→聚合→全文润色。适用于技术文档、分析报告、教程等。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: code_reviewer
templates.title: 代码审查与修复
templates.description: 标准代码审查工作流: 读取源码 → 运行测试 → 定位失败根因 → 最小修改 → 重新验证 → 生成报告。这是最核心的软件开发质量保证流程。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: task_decomposer
templates.title: 任务分解与规划
templates.description: 将复杂任务分解为可执行的子任务并按依赖排序。输入任务描述→LLM拆解→提取子任务→依赖排序→生成格式化计划。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: data_analyzer
templates.title: 数据分析流水线
templates.description: 标准数据分析工作流：加载数据→统计摘要→异常检测→生成报告。适用于CSV/JSON数据的自动化分析场景。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: document_summarizer
templates.title: 文档摘要生成器
templates.description: 阅读文档并生成多层级摘要：一句话总结→三段要点→完整摘要。适用于合同、论文、长文等场景。

build_plan.goal: Build customer support routing BlockFlow with classification, routing, and reviewer-facing outputs.
build_plan.strategy: Deep reuse via customer_support_router template expansion, then adapt and extend.

modules.title: Template expansion and inspection
evidence: Template expanded: 5 nodes (start, question_classifier, if_else, template_transform, end), 4 edges
Template already has 4-class classifier (complaint, question, feedback, urgent) and if_else routing
Gaps: missing customer_tier input, missing priority output, no differentiated routing paths, no LLM response generation, no tests

modules.title: Input/output wiring
modules.purpose: Wire customer_message, customer_tier inputs and intent/response/priority outputs.
evidence: customer_tier referenced in template_transform prompt builder
End outputs: intent (classifier), priority (LLM structured), response (LLM structured)

modules.title: Classification and routing
modules.purpose: Classify into 4 categories and route urgent/complaint differently.
evidence: question_classifier with 4 classes: complaint, question, feedback, urgent
if_else with 4 branch cases routing to template_transform
LLM differentiates: high priority for urgent/complaint, normal for question/feedback

modules.title: Response generation
modules.purpose: Generate reviewer-facing response with intent, priority, response text.
evidence: template_transform builds prompt from message, tier, intent
LLM generates structured JSON with intent, priority, response

modules.title: Mandatory tests
evidence: 4 mandatory tests covering all classification branches
All tests include required_node_types for auditability
Tests verify intent, priority, and response for each branch

risks: Template may need modification for 4-way classification

input.requirement: Customer support routing BlockFlow that classifies messages into complaint, question, feedback, or urgent, routes urgent/complaint cases differently from standard questions, produces a reviewer-facing support response with intent, priority, and response text. Inputs: customer_message, optional customer_tier. Outputs: intent, response, priority.
